# @trysac/chat-transcript-format

> Convert chat transcripts between OpenAI chat, Anthropic Messages and Gemini contents formats with text and base64 images, explicit errors for anything lossy TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

- [README](README.md): problem, installation and usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how tests and coverage work
